query: SELECT GaiaDR3, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(MJD) AS tmin, MAX(MJD) AS tmax, MIN(RVcomp1) AS rvmin, MAX(RVcomp1) AS rvmax FROM "J/other/PASA/42.51/allspec" WHERE flagSp = 0 and e_RVcomp1 > 0 and e_RVcomp1 < 2 and SNRpxCCD2 > 30 and logg > 3.7 and Teff between 4000 and 7000 GROUP BY GaiaDR3 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
